subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter series and answer the question.

M O V E O I F V A S K C O S D V I N S D I N I S

How many such consonants are there each of which is immediately preceded by a vowel and also immediately followed by a vowel?
solution:
Given Alphabets: M O V E O I F V A S K C O S D V I N S D I N I S

Consonants are immediately preceded by a vowel and also immediately followed by a vowel,

So, the pattern should be: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ad205578a39cc3139708b2f81af036551d19b9be93a3731ba43aa73f47dc88d.png] 

Now,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fa25bb1b19c7e5673b50fe70a94833304f986e4edb27a9e4ad0f721d98f873b.png] 

So, there are Two pairs i.e.: 'OVE' and 'INI'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
